summary: We are hiring for a Software Engineer Intern role focused on building scalable backend and full-stack systems, collaborating with the team to develop impactful applications across different domains.
responsibilities: Full Stack Development: Build and maintain scalable web applications using TypeScript and other such frameworks.
AI Focused Engineering: Develop applications in speech technology, B2B SaaS, workforce scheduling, and conversational AI
API Development: Create RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints with proper documentation and testing
Use of AI Tools: Accelerate development using tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Technology Stack: Work with the MERN stack, Python frameworks, and vector orchestration tools like LangChain and LangGraph
Database Management: Design and maintain relational and non-relational databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis
Marketplace Integrations: Build integrations with third-party APIs and external ecosystems
AI System Optimisation: Enhance the performance and scalability of AI systems for real-time use cases
Data Analysis: Work with large datasets to extract insights and support AI feature development
Prototyping and Testing: Rapidly build and test prototypes with a strong focus on quality assurance
required_skills: Strong foundation in Computer Science and Object-Oriented Programming
Previous work or projects that demonstrate your skills and ability to deliver impact
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills with attention to edge cases
nice_to_have_skills: Ability to work independently and manage time effectively
Continuous Learning: Stay current with global AI advancements and adopt them in everyday work
benefits: Remote First: Work from anywhere, on your own productive schedule
Team First: We believe that great products are built through collaboration
Performance Focused: We value how fast you learn, how creatively you think, and how accountable you are. These 3 parameters decide your impact at Xoidlabs.

Flexible Hours: Your productivity matters and we keep your working hours flexible as per whenever you stay most productive(usually starting early morning helps people to keep their days most impactful)
Innovation Friendly: We encourage early adoption of new technologies and welcome bold ideas
